visual_review.notes: The formerly empty scene now clearly reads as a forest road, with dense canopy, varied crown sizes and forest-floor texture. The car and road remain visible in both zooms. Tree positions, species and crowns are procedural; the foliage is repetitive, and mapped path ribbons and uniform verges still look artificial.

visual_review.status: Limited - class variation added; boundaries need blending
visual_review.notes: Ground is now divided into grass, sparse/bare and shrub areas, with low shrubs and no invented tall trees. However the raster boundaries are visibly blocky and the grass colour is too uniform to establish a convincing dry landscape. Regional and seasonal material treatment is still needed; this is not accepted as a faithful Tabernas replica.
